related.title: Redfish 控制鏈：觀察年齡與致動截止時間
related.titleEn: Redfish control chains: observation age and actuation deadline
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩熱庫圖、絕對溫度核算、15 kW 反證與供熱/發電邊界說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the reservoir diagram, absolute-temperature calculations, the 15 kW counterexample and separate direct-heating and electricity boundaries. Clearly label ideal limits rather than presenting them as achievable output. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 事件表記 metric_obtained、report_generated、received、queued、actuation_complete，附 metric property 與設備識別；缺失時間不可當零。
related.differenceEn: Record metric obtained, report generated, received, queued and actuation-complete events, preserving metric property and equipment identity. Missing timestamps are unknown, not zero age or permission to substitute report time.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定兩熱庫的理想功率上界為 Qhot*(1-Tcold/Thot)，溫度必須為 K；有限流體冷卻過程不等同固定熱庫；熱輸入 100 kW、冷庫 293 K；熱庫由 313 增為 323 K。此例不含泵耗與實際轉換設備；名義式 100*(1-293/313) = 6.38977635783 kW ideal work bound；變更式 100*(1-293/323) = 9.28792569659 kW ideal work bound。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

本課串行反應鏈時間為取得有效觀察延遲加控制排隊加致動完成時間；報告時間與每項 metric 時間需分開；有效觀察延遲 4 秒、致動 2 秒；控制排隊由 3 增為 10 秒；教學外部截止時間為 12 秒；名義式 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain；變更式 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Between fixed-temperature reservoirs, ideal work output is bounded by Qhot*(1-Tcold/Thot), with temperatures in kelvin. A finite stream cooling over a range is not identical to this reservoir model. Supply 100 kW of heat to a hypothetical engine with a 293 K cold reservoir. Hot-reservoir temperature changes from 313 to 323 K, excluding pumps and any actual conversion equipment. Nominal 100*(1-293/313) = 6.38977635783 kW ideal work bound; changed 100*(1-293/323) = 9.28792569659 kW ideal work bound. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The serial response chain adds delay to obtain a valid observation, control queueing and completed actuation time. Keep report time distinct from each metric’s timestamp and from receipt time. Valid-observation delay is 4 seconds and actuation takes 2 seconds. Control queueing changes from 3 to 10 seconds, against an externally specified teaching deadline of 12 seconds. Nominal 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain; changed 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: QMCPACK：自相關、有效樣本與量子蒙地卡羅誤差
related.titleEn: QMCPACK: autocorrelation, effective samples and Monte Carlo uncertainty
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩熱庫圖、絕對溫度核算、15 kW 反證與供熱/發電邊界說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the reservoir diagram, absolute-temperature calculations, the 15 kW counterexample and separate direct-heating and electricity boundaries. Clearly label ideal limits rather than presenting them as achievable output. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「QMCPACK：自相關、有效樣本與量子蒙地卡羅誤差」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付去平衡化紀錄、相關與區塊圖、有效樣本帳本及帶不確定度的能量報告。
related.differenceEn: Investigate QMCPACK: autocorrelation, effective samples and Monte Carlo uncertainty using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver equilibration decisions, correlation and blocking plots, an effective-sample ledger and an energy report that separates statistical uncertainty from systematic discretization or trial-wavefunction bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

算 g=4 時 Neff=100，再以兩種等價公式得標準誤；與錯誤獨立假設 g=1 的結果比較。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Between fixed-temperature reservoirs, ideal work output is bounded by Qhot*(1-Tcold/Thot), with temperatures in kelvin. A finite stream cooling over a range is not identical to this reservoir model. Supply 100 kW of heat to a hypothetical engine with a 293 K cold reservoir. Hot-reservoir temperature changes from 313 to 323 K, excluding pumps and any actual conversion equipment. Nominal 100*(1-293/313) = 6.38977635783 kW ideal work bound; changed 100*(1-293/323) = 9.28792569659 kW ideal work bound. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

For g=4 calculate Neff=100 and obtain the standard error using both equivalent formulas. Compare with the deliberately incorrect independent-sample assumption g=1, explaining why identical raw sample counts can support different uncertainty estimates.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
